name: Picture shrinker
description: Shrinks the posters and photos of people Jellyfin keeps, so they take less space. You choose: keep a backup of each original, or just shrink.
author: TheMightyTRexUK

settings.label: Original pictures

choices.label: Keep a backup copy of each original

settings.hint: Nothing is shrunk until you choose. A backup copy is made once, in this plug-in's own folder, before a picture's first shrink, so Restore original pictures can put it back. With no backup, a shrunk picture cannot be put back, but Start again has Jellyfin download it again.

settings.label: Shrink all picture types
settings.hint: Activated when you add it: every type below is shrunk. Deactivate it to choose types one by one.

settings.label: Posters
settings.hint: The poster of each film, series, season and collection. Used when Shrink all picture types is deactivated.

settings.label: Photos of cast and crew
settings.hint: The photo of each actor, director and writer.

settings.label: Backdrops
settings.hint: The wide picture behind each film and series.

settings.label: Thumbnails
settings.hint: The landscape picture some apps show for a film or series.

settings.label: Logos
settings.hint: The title logo of a film or series. PNG logos stay lossless.

settings.label: Banners
settings.hint: The long, thin banner of a series.

settings.label: Disc art
settings.hint: The picture of a disc.

settings.label: Clear art
settings.hint: Characters and title on a see-through background.

settings.label: Posters no taller than
settings.hint: A poster taller than this is shrunk to this height. 900 pixels looks sharp on a television.

settings.label: Photos of people no wider than
settings.hint: A photo of a cast or crew member wider than this is shrunk to this width.

settings.label: Backdrops no wider than
settings.hint: 1920 pixels is sharp on a 1080p screen and a little softer full-screen on a 4K television.

settings.label: Thumbnails no wider than
settings.hint: A thumbnail wider than this is shrunk to this width.

settings.label: Logos no wider than
settings.hint: A logo wider than this is shrunk to this width.

settings.label: Banners no wider than
settings.hint: A banner wider than this is shrunk to this width.

settings.label: Disc art no wider than
settings.hint: Disc art wider than this is shrunk to this width.

settings.label: Clear art no wider than
settings.hint: Clear art wider than this is shrunk to this width.

settings.label: Quality
settings.hint: For JPEG and WebP pictures, from 50 to 100. 85 keeps them sharp; lower saves more space. PNG pictures stay lossless.

settings.label: When to shrink
settings.hint: Every day, week or month, at a time. It works at the lowest priority, so a time when the server is quiet is best.

settings.label: Shrink new pictures in quiet hours
settings.hint: Each hour of quiet hours, shrinks the posters and photos Jellyfin saved since the last pass, so they never build up.

actions.label: Restore original pictures
actions.confirm: Put the original pictures from the backup back in Jellyfin? The backup is kept. Change When to shrink first, or the next run shrinks them again.

actions.label: Delete backup
actions.confirm: Delete the backup for good? The original pictures in it are removed and Restore original pictures can no longer put those pictures back. The shrunk pictures stay in Jellyfin. The Space saved page says how much this frees.

actions.label: Start again: the pictures it shrinks
actions.confirm: Delete the backup and the plug-in's records, and have Jellyfin download again, at full size, every picture it shrinks: posters, backdrops, thumbnails, logos, banners, disc art, clear art and photos of people? Your backup choice is kept. A picture not downloaded again is put back after a day.

actions.label: Start again: every picture
actions.confirm: Delete the backup and the plug-in's records, and have Jellyfin download every picture again, backdrops and logos included? Pictures you added yourself in Jellyfin are replaced. This downloads much more and can take many hours.

logo.alt: A picture with an arrow pointing into its corner

added: **Choose the backup:** Original pictures asks whether to keep a backup copy of each original or just shrink, once it is added and again after this update. Nothing is shrunk until you choose; a backup you already have is kept.

**Start again** in its actions, for the pictures it shrinks or for every picture: deletes the backup and the records, and has Jellyfin download the pictures again at full size. A picture Jellyfin cannot download again is put back after a day.

**Every picture type:** posters, photos of people, backdrops, thumbnails, logos, banners, disc art and clear art, each with its own size and all activated, with **Shrink all picture types** for all in one setting. Backdrops asked for by Lentzeris (issue #2).
changed: **Rules 1.2:** the same rules file as the Jellyfin version (SYNC.md).
**Settings in sections:** What to shrink (with Original pictures), Sizes and quality, and When it runs. After this update, check What to shrink: every type is shrunk until you choose otherwise.
removed: **Back up each original before it is replaced:** replaced by Original pictures.

changed: **Lighter at rest:** it wakes about once a minute while nothing asks it anything, not twice a second.
**Starts faster:** its image comes with Python's modules already compiled, so a start takes about a quarter of the processor time.

added: **Backup first:** each original is copied to the plug-in's own folder before its first shrink, and a picture whose original cannot be backed up is not shrunk. Activated by default.
**Restore original pictures** and **Delete backup** in its actions; Space saved shows the pictures now, the backup and the space saved.
**Quality, posters and photos of people** are settings, as in the Jellyfin version.
**Stays idle when Jellyfin's own Picture shrinker is installed**, so the two never shrink the same pictures. To see that, it reads Jellyfin's list of plug-ins with Jellyfin's key.
changed: **Rules 1.1:** the same rules file as the Jellyfin version (SYNC.md).
**Quiet when it finishes:** a run changes only the figures on its card and page; the card no longer shows a problem status.

added: **Shrinks Jellyfin's pictures:** posters to 900 pixels tall and photos of cast and crew to 400 pixels wide, both settings. Smaller pictures are left alone.
**Checked before it replaces:** each picture is written beside the original, opened again and checked, and swapped in only when it is smaller.
**When you choose:** every day, week or month at a time, with Shrink now, at the lowest priority.
**New pictures in quiet hours:** deactivated unless you activate it.
**Space saved:** on its page and on a dashboard card.
